item.title: MiBeeNvr: From v0.1.0 to v0.12.0
item.description: MiBeeNvr is an NVR built for a home camera fleet. v0.1.0 shipped on May 6, 2026; v0.12.0 on September 1 — twelve releases in a bit over four months. This post merges the per-release notes from v0.1.0 through v0.12.0 into one timeline: what each step did, and why. The house style for mechanisms is plain words first, then a picture, then the parameters. The v0.13.0 performance benchmarks are a separate post, linked at the end.

item.title: Adaptive Recording and Storage Design in MiBeeNvr
item.description: Outside writeups of MiBeeNvr’s adaptive recording mostly stop at “motion-aware, saves disk”: what signal drives the gating, why the switch loses no frames, and which cameras it fails on rarely get covered. This post takes all three apart — plain words first, then a picture, then the parameters, with a full glossary at the end. Mechanism descriptions are based on the v0.13.0 documentation and release records (October 2026); the version-by-version timeline is in MiBeeNvr: From v0.1.0 to v0.12.0.
